title: STUDIO VOID
subtitle: Design Composition Showcase
description: A scroll-only digital showcase exploring screen space, typography, and motion. Features adaptive grids, relative scaling, and mouse-controlled parallax depth.

title: MOSAIC SANDBOX
subtitle: Triangular Grid
description: An interactive grid of CSS triangles that dynamically shift colors in response to mouse movement.

title: LIMITS
subtitle: Raymarching Engine
description: A real-time raymarching engine rendering complex fractal geometry (Mandelbox, Mandelbulb, Menger sponge) via fragment shaders. Features custom palettes and audio synthesis.

title: PERSONA UI
subtitle: Stylized Interface Recreation
description: A dynamic recreation of highly stylized video game menus. Features bold high-contrast typography, angular layouts, and snappy micro-animations.

title: COMIFURO CATALOG
subtitle: Interactive Circle Archive & Floor Map
description: An interactive catalog and vector floor map archiving 1,957 creative circles across ICE BSD Halls 5–6. Features multi-criteria filtering, content rating segmentation, and live booth location mapping.
